| Model | Type | Predicts | Example run |
|---|---|---|---|
| **KarstBinary** (`ac1eb985...`) | fine_tuned | per_pixel_regression — one score value per pixel | KarstBinary PA regular (completed) |
| **KarstNumber** (`f67d97d9...`) | fine_tuned | per_pixel_regression — one value per pixel | KarstNumber PA regular (completed) |

There's also **KarstEmbedding** (`5aafb53d...`), which is an embeddings model (features, no prediction_type output).
